definitions.explanation: The state of being difficult or troublesome.

examples.japanese: {不便|ふべん}な⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I live in an inconvenient location.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まって→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧、⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不便|ふべん}だった。
examples.english: The train stopped running, so it was inconvenient to go shopping.

notes:
{不便|ふべん} is a na-adjective meaning inconvenient or inconvenience.

KANJI:
{不|ふ} (not) + {便|べん} (convenience) - not convenient.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {不便|ふべん}な{場所|ばしょ} (inconvenient place)
- Noun: {不便|ふべん}を{感|かん}じる (to feel inconvenience)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {不便|ふべん}をかける: to cause inconvenience
- {不便|ふべん}なく: without inconvenience
- {交通|こうつう}の{不便|ふべん}な: with poor transportation access

CONTRAST:
- {不便|ふべん}: inconvenient (negative)
- {便利|べんり}: convenient (positive)

USAGE:
{不便|ふべん}をおかけして{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません is a polite apology for causing inconvenience.
